_readme: Cutscenes played by CutsceneDirector (src/cutscene/cutscene_director.gd). Owned by Fahd.
lines: line id -> speaker, text, optional audio (res://res/audio/voice/<id>.ogg). Cutscene lines live only here, never in lines.json or dialogue_triggers.json, so they can't also play as triggers.

cutscenes: id -> on (campaign_start: a new campaign's first level load; manual: started by code; else a dialogue-trigger event such as objective:<id> or mission_completed:<id>), letterbox (bars, default true), hold_dialogue (trigger lines fired meanwhile wait until it ends), shots.

A shot: name, duration (s), optional black (title card background), fade_in (s from black), title {text, caption, text_in, caption_in, out}, caption (top bar text), camera, actions, lines [{id, at}]. Times inside a shot are seconds from its start.

camera, either from/to {pos, look, fov} as offsets in world axes from anchor (a node path from the level root; its place when the cutscene started, or where it is now with live: true), with optional look_node (+ look_offset) followed live; or frame (node) with side (the node whose side the camera is on; @kite is the rover, @player the player), turn (deg), distance, height, fov (a number or [from, to]) and look_height. ease: linear, in, out, in_out (default). The camera is kept 1 m above the terrain.

actions: {at, do, node, ...}: path (keys [[t, x, y, z], ...], offsets in world axes from the node's place at the start, smooth through every key, stopping at the last), call (method, args), visible (on), place_player (stands the player on the node, facing its -Z; the full astronaut stands in for them, stepping out to it). Lines without a recording stay up 0.5 s + 1 s per 14 characters and play one after another: time them so each starts after the previous ends, or the shot holds at its end until it starts. Skipping applies every action's end state.

cs_open_01.speaker: Mira
cs_open_01.text: Rotation one, Surface Research Programme. This is Mira, systems support, from Earth.

cs_open_02.speaker: Mira
cs_open_02.text: You're the crew's astronaut and its robotics engineer. Anything down there with wheels is now your problem.

cs_open_03.speaker: Mira
cs_open_03.text: It's a small crew. Hana and I are with you from here, about a second behind.

cs_open_04.speaker: Hana
cs_open_04.text: Hana, science lead. That's Head crater under you. IRIS is just past it, and it's been silent for four years.

cs_open_05.speaker: Hana
cs_open_05.text: The last crew ran out of spare parts. The replacement stock missed their rotation, so they had to go home and leave it.

cs_open_06.speaker: Hana
cs_open_06.text: Part of its archive never reached Earth. Evan, their field technician, labelled everything twice. You'll see.

cs_open_08.speaker: Hana
cs_open_08.text: No air to hold the dust up. It's already coming down.

cs_open_09.speaker: Mira
cs_open_09.text: The workshop is a short walk ahead. Kite's in the bay. It's waited four years; it can manage another minute.
